checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One playable vertical reel, approx 8 seconds
must.why: The clip is 16:9 landscape (858x480), not vertical, and runs 10.1 s rather than about 8 s.

The dog, cat, curly-haired woman and lake show in the sampled frames. The beach couple is not in any sampled frame. The curly-haired woman and the lake have no supplied source photo to compare against.

must.item: Visible playful treatment (bouncy motion, comic timing, lively transitions, humorous overlays)
must.why: The frames show realistic, calm AI-animated scenes. There are no playful overlays, text or comic styling. The only extra is falling leaves in the woman scene.

must.item: Faces and pets remain recognizable and unobscured
must.why: The dog and cat closely match their photos and are unobscured. The woman's face is clear, apart from a leaf drifting across her neck.

must.item: Single edited sequence, not separate clips or a contact sheet
must.why: It is one continuous video of consecutive scenes.

faults.what: Output is 16:9 landscape, not vertical reel format
Length is 10 s, not about 8 s
No playful or comic editing. It reads as a plain slideshow of realistic scenes
The beach couple scene is not visible in the sampled frames, so it cannot be confirmed
The dog photo was re-generated with a different framing and tail pose. The scenes are AI reinterpretations, not the exact photos
A falling leaf overlaps the woman's neck

summary: The result is a clean 10-second landscape montage of the dog, cat, curly-haired woman and lake, but it is not vertical and has no playful treatment, and the beach couple could not be confirmed.
